question_vi: Template literal types trong TypeScript là gì?
question_en: What are template literal types in TypeScript?
answer_html_vi:
Template literal types tạo string types từ combinations.

  • Kết hợp với union thì dựng được type an toàn cho event name, CSS property, API endpoint.
  • Intrinsic types: Uppercase, Lowercase, Capitalize, Uncapitalize.
typescript
type EventName = `on${Capitalize<string>}`;
type Side = 'top' | 'bottom' | 'left' | 'right';
type Padding = `padding-${Side}`; // "padding-top" | "padding-bottom" | ...

type Handlers = { [K in EventName]?: () => void };
// Dùng trong event bus, styled-components, API path generation
answer_html_en:
Template literal types create string types from combinations.

  • Combined with unions, they give you type-safe event names, CSS properties, and API endpoints.
  • Intrinsic types: Uppercase, Lowercase, Capitalize, Uncapitalize.
typescript
type EventName = `on${Capitalize<string>}`;
type Side = 'top' | 'bottom' | 'left' | 'right';
type Padding = `padding-${Side}`; // "padding-top" | "padding-bottom" | ...

type Handlers = { [K in EventName]?: () => void };
// Used in event buses, styled-components, API path generation
